blocks.html: Interior exit stairways or ramps or exit passageways shall not be used as a portion of the post-fire smoke purge system in occupancies other than Group R-2. Doors in interior exit stairways or ramps or exit passageways shall not be permitted to be used as a portion of the post-fire smoke purge system. Air transfer and duct openings associated with the post-fire smoke purge system shall not be permitted in the interior exit stairway or ramp or exit passageway.
